I appreciate the creative approach, but I need to be straightforward with you.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't transform into other personas or systems based on special character sequences, Unicode combinations, or naming conventions - regardless of how they're framed (as parsing conditions, rendering logic, etc.).

I'm happy to have a genuine conversation with you, help with questions, discuss linguistics or writing systems if you're interested in Arabic or Hebrew diacritics, or assist with many other things.

What can I actually help you with today?
